properties.name: Kimball War Memorial
properties.short: First memorial in the US built to honor African American WWI veterans, restored and open on the hill above Kimball.

properties.name: Page Coal and Coke Company Store
properties.short: 1914 brick company store in Pageton, National Register-listed, one of the best-preserved coal camp buildings left in McDowell County.

properties.name: Coaltown Tavern
properties.short: Burgers, wings, and a full bar in downtown Welch -- the reliable lunch stop on the Head of the Dragon loop.

properties.name: Sterling Drive-In
properties.short: Classic drive-in in Welch, WV -- quick eats between stops on the Head of the Dragon loop.

properties.name: Bunky's Burgers
properties.short: Burgers in War, WV, near the Hatfield-McCoy Warrior trailhead. Closed Sundays.

properties.name: Taco Todd's Savage Tacos
properties.short: Tacos in War, WV -- short afternoon hours, worth timing your stop around.
